question: What does the book say about personal piety and worship of God?
answer:
Islam (is) personal piety and worship of God in a framework of revealed universal ethical principles which are to be implemented in human life. [1]

Islam in its personal pietism and Quranic ethical universalism is meant to do this. [1]

Sources
[1] Muqaddima Seerat ur Rasool 1 1 · PDF page 51 — «Islam (is) personal piety and worship of God in a framework of revealed universal ethical principles which are to be implemented in human life.»
